title: Huntik International HQ
summary: Huntik International HQ is the main headquarters of the Huntik Foundation where the Huntik Foundation Council meets to discuss the progress and problems of the Seeker world. This base is located in Manhattan, New York.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
When Metz, the leader of the Council, fell victim to the Curse of the Legendary Titans, the HQ hosted hologram meetings. [Coming of Age] However, following Metz' recovery, the Council members gathered in the HQ and started to deliberate again. [The Tower of Nostradamus]

The Council discussed the reemergence of the Organization following the defeat of the Professor. Nasher then alerted the Council that his Seekers in Tower of Nostradamus had been attacked by the Organization. [The Tower of Nostradamus]

When Focauld Casterwill alerted Teien Casterwill that the Blood Spiral had found him, Metz allowed her to bring the matter before the Council. [The Casterwill Connection] Dante's team later came before the Council to discuss the Blood Spiral and were tasked with the mission Call of the Casterwill. [The Titan in the Temple of Sun]

The Council gathered in the International HQ on the longest night of the year to discuss plans to stop the activation of the Spiral Mark. [Words from Eathon] Several members, including Metz, Momax, Guggenheim and Teien fought during the final battle against the Blood Spiral. [Dante's Return]

Following the defeat of The Betrayer, the Huntik Council gathered at the International HQ, now joined by a new member, Dante Vale. [Dante's Return]

full_text:
Huntik International HQ is the main headquarters of the Huntik Foundation where the Huntik Foundation Council meets to discuss the progress and problems of the Seeker world. This base is located in Manhattan, New York.

== History ==
When Metz, the leader of the Council, fell victim to the Curse of the Legendary Titans, the HQ hosted hologram meetings. [Coming of Age] However, following Metz' recovery, the Council members gathered in the HQ and started to deliberate again. [The Tower of Nostradamus]

The Council discussed the reemergence of the Organization following the defeat of the Professor. Nasher then alerted the Council that his Seekers in Tower of Nostradamus had been attacked by the Organization. [The Tower of Nostradamus]

When Focauld Casterwill alerted Teien Casterwill that the Blood Spiral had found him, Metz allowed her to bring the matter before the Council. [The Casterwill Connection] Dante's team later came before the Council to discuss the Blood Spiral and were tasked with the mission Call of the Casterwill. [The Titan in the Temple of Sun]

The Council gathered in the International HQ on the longest night of the year to discuss plans to stop the activation of the Spiral Mark. [Words from Eathon] Several members, including Metz, Momax, Guggenheim and Teien fought during the final battle against the Blood Spiral. [Dante's Return]

Following the defeat of The Betrayer, the Huntik Council gathered at the International HQ, now joined by a new member, Dante Vale. [Dante's Return]
